limitations: Unity custom shaders are approximated by Blender/glTF PBR materials; original parameters are retained.
Standalone animation files preserve transform channels on an empty hierarchy; this does not automatically bind them to every character.
Blend shapes, animation events and non-transform property curves remain in original Unity sources, not glTF.
